title: World Chronicle
description: A personal journal that writes itself
body:
The mod adds a Chronicle of your world that records the main events you achieve in your playthrough. The first death, the first night survived, the first diamond mined - all of it is written down in the chronicle, and you can reread it later in the game, remembering the old days. You can also add your own entries. The chronicle has a "Map" tab so you can see where the events that mattered to you took place - and a "Diary" tab, a free-form page for each day where you write, draw, and decorate your own memories.
![chronicle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/145daffbeed395bdbffc0332fe445c29b9dc3116.jpeg)

1) What gets recorded — 51 events + 6 anniversaries + easter eggs + manual notes.
2) The book itself — event icons, aging ink, wax seals, quill animation, gilt-edged pages, leather texture.
3) Discovery Map — parchment map with markers, player arrow, and zoom.
4) Permanent inventory slot — always in your inventory from the first second, no crafting needed.
5) Diary — a personal scrapbook page for every day
